method.counter_coverage: Observed sampler timestamps counted separately by session. Engine utilization is summed across process engines of one type; process and adapter memory peaks are the largest individual observed counter values.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank over observed values; missing observations remain counted separately.
method.phase_throughput: Duration-weighted average of the native prompt_per_second or predicted_per_second. The native decode rate can exclude the first token.
method.request_wall_ms: CaptureClient chat HTTP request wall time. The separate template-render request is outside this clock.
method.task_recorded_wall_ms: Historical runner's sum of step request wall times, including recorded step errors.
